facts.fact: The MoCDTI request for bids issued 12 June 2026 describes the Government's National Data Center as a Primary Data Center in Accra and a Secondary Data Center in Kumasi, both existing and to be refreshed (main site in Accra, backup in Kumasi); the document does not call the Kumasi site a backup or disaster-recovery site by name.
facts.system: National Data Center (Primary in Accra, Secondary in Kumasi)

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations
Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations

note: Tender for refresh and upgrade; the contract is not in service, but the Accra and Kumasi centres it refreshes are stated as existing. No plan, test or Tier statement about the backup.
